name: Eira Solenne
spritePrompt: Entirely original character for Multiverse Breach, no existing franchise reference. A radiant cosmic botanist in deep green field robes, translucent leaf visor, floating seed-orbs, gold root embroidery and a staff holding a miniature photosphere. Complete 4 by 4 pixel-art combat sprite sheet: idle, run, attack, hit reactions; consistent silhouette and equipment; isolated on flat chroma green background; no text, no logo, no frame.

lore.en: A star-seed botanist who listens to the futures sleeping inside extinct suns. Eira refuses to cultivate only profitable constellations.
lore.fr: Botaniste des graines stellaires qui écoute les futurs endormis dans les soleils éteints. Eira refuse de cultiver uniquement les constellations rentables.
